identity: A team chat and meeting widget with channel messages, threads, channel settings, meeting controls, and breakout room assignments.

scenarios.name: thread
scenarios.screen: A channel shows several messages, including the message to reply to, with an empty channel composer below them. The target thread is closed, and no reply draft is open.
never: The target thread open on load.
The requested reply entered in the channel composer.

arrangements.text: Messages run vertically above the channel composer, with each message's thread control beside it.
Messages run vertically above the channel composer, with each message's thread control below its text.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: message controls below text

scenarios.name: pinreact
scenarios.screen: A channel shows several messages, including the target message, with message actions available beside the conversation. The target is unpinned, its requested reaction is absent, and the emoji picker is closed.
never: The emoji picker open on load.
The requested reaction already attached to the target message.

arrangements.text: Messages run vertically, with reaction and more-action controls beside each message.
Messages run vertically, with reaction and more-action controls below each message.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: message controls below text

scenarios.name: channel
scenarios.screen: The current channel shows its name and several messages, with an empty message composer below the conversation. Channel settings and the invitation picker are closed; the existing name, topic, and membership have not been changed.
never: The channel settings panel open on load.
The invitation picker open on load.
The requested new channel name already saved.

arrangements.text: The channel name and settings control sit above the message list, with the composer below it.
The channel name sits above the message list, with the settings control beside the composer below it.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: settings control beside composer

scenarios.name: meeting
scenarios.screen: A meeting view shows microphone, sharing, and hand controls. The microphone is on, no window is being shared, the hand is down, and the sharing picker is closed.
never: The sharing picker open on load.

arrangements.text: The microphone, sharing, and hand controls sit in one row below the meeting area.
The microphone, sharing, and hand controls sit in one column beside the meeting area.

scenarios.name: breakout
scenarios.screen: The breakout manager shows a participant list and three named rooms, with about six participants available to assign. The participants start outside the rooms, and the room lists are empty.
never: A participant card already outside its list or room.
More rooms than the three named rooms.
A room assignment confirmation dialog open on load.

arrangements.text: The participant list sits to the left of three room lists arranged side by side.
Three room lists stack to the left of the participant list.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: stacked rooms on left
